answer: Locks are published in juniper, expire in knoll, and nebula lists each expiry. An farming party running 139 aliases therefore needs 89 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 24 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2641 identities would post 1155 proofs and burn roughly 81 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
